name: Our Words
overview: Scripture reveals the profound power and responsibility inherent in our words, emphasizing that the tongue can bring life or death, and that careless speech can lead to trouble while careful speech preserves the soul. Believers are called to honor God's name, avoiding taking it in vain, and to seek that their words and the meditations of their hearts be pleasing to the Lord. Pleasant and wholesome words are likened to honeycomb, bringing sweetness and health to the soul, while prayer begins with reverence for God's holy name, underscoring the centrality of honoring God in all we say.
